verses.text: “Don’t judge people, or you’ll be judged too.”
“The way you judge is how you’ll be judged; the measure you use is the measure you’ll get back.”
“Why are you clocking the speck in your brother’s eye while ignoring the plank in your own?”
“How can you tell your brother, ‘Let me get that speck out of your eye,’ when there’s a whole plank in yours?”
“Hypocrite! Get the plank out of your own eye first. Then you’ll see clearly enough to help with the speck in your brother’s eye.”
“Don’t give what’s holy to dogs, or throw your pearls to pigs. They’ll trample them, then turn around and attack you.”
“Ask, and it’ll be given to you; seek, and you’ll find; knock, and the door will open. 🚪”
“Everyone who asks receives; everyone who seeks finds; and the door opens for the one who knocks.”
“If your child asks you for bread, who would hand them a stone?”
“Or if they ask for a fish, who would hand them a snake?”
“If you, imperfect as you are, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask him?”
“So treat people the way you want them to treat you. That’s the Law and the Prophets in a nutshell.”
“Go in through the narrow gate. The gate to destruction is wide and the road there is easy, so plenty of people take it.”
“But the gate to life is narrow, and the road is hard to find. Only a few find it.”
“Watch out for false prophets. They come dressed like sheep, but inside they’re hungry wolves.”
“You’ll recognize them by what they produce. Do people pick grapes from thornbushes or figs from thistles?”
“Every good tree grows good fruit, but a rotten tree grows bad fruit.”
“A good tree can’t grow bad fruit, and a rotten tree can’t grow good fruit.”
“Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit gets cut down and thrown into the fire.”
“So, you’ll know them by the fruit they grow.”
“Not everyone who calls me ‘Lord, Lord’ will enter Heaven’s Kingdom. The one who does the will of my Father in heaven will.”
“Many will say to me that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, drive out demons in your name, and do many mighty works in your name?’”
“Then I’ll tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you. Get away from me, you who practice evil.’”
“So everyone who hears what I’m saying and lives it out is like a wise person who built a house on rock.”
“The rain came down, floods came, and winds hit that house hard—but it didn’t fall, because it was built on rock.”
“But everyone who hears what I’m saying and doesn’t live it out is like a foolish person who built a house on sand.”
“The rain came down, floods came, and winds slammed that house. It fell—and the crash was huge.”
When Jesus finished teaching, the crowds were amazed by what he’d said.
He taught with real authority, nothing like their teachers of the Law.
